constraints: Use one consistent event time window across retries and pages.
Do not persist real identifiers, IP addresses, endpoint URLs, headers, tokens, cookies, or raw responses in Git.
Do not send RFC5737 fixture addresses to a real XDR query as if they were runtime entities.
Authorization header: algorithm=HMAC-SHA256, Access=<ak>, SignedHeaders=<headers>, Signature=<hex_upper> — generated locally, never commit the ak/sk/auth_code.
